bias.en: Rebound · back above the 100 and 200-day, SAR bullish
bias.zh: 反弹 · 重回 100 日和 200 日均线上方，SAR 看多

read.en: Meta rose 5.1% on Nov 9 to $641.37, trading $630.00–647.25. It is above the rising 5-day ($621.5) and 100-day ($634.2) and the falling 10-day ($618.7) and 200-day ($631.9) averages, but below the falling 30-day ($681.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, with the histogram fading toward a cross; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Nov 9 ($583.8), and RSI is 46.5.
read.zh: Meta 11月9日上涨 5.1%，收于 $641.37，盘中区间 $630.00–647.25。股价位于上行的 5 日（$621.5）和 100 日均线（$634.2），以及下行的 10 日（$618.7）和 200 日均线（$631.9）上方，但仍低于下行的 30 日均线（$681.8）。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄、趋向金叉；抛物线 SAR 于 11月9日翻为看多（$583.8），RSI 为 46.5。

read.en: The rally broke the $614.6–617.6 and $631.9–635 resistances (5, 10, 100 and 200-day, Nov 5 high), now support, but the $647.25 high stopped near the $643.1–648 area. Resistance is $643.1–648 (Nov 4, Nov 9 and Oct 23 highs), then $681.1–681.8 (Oct 22 high, 30-day). Support is $630–635, then $618.7–624.8 and $606.4–610.1. A close above $648 would target $681–682; below $630, $619–625.

r.en: Nov 4 high $643.09; Nov 9 high $647.25; Oct 23 high $648.04

s.en: 100 and 200-day averages ($631.9–634.2), reclaimed; Nov 5 high $635.0; Nov 9 low $630
Nov 2 low $606.4; Nov 6 low $606.66; Oct 30 and Nov 3 lows $610.1
